## Requirements (contract § In scope)

1. Rehearsal harness (committed): dry-run-by-default command that, against
   a named clone only, runs `sqitch deploy --verify` to the plan tip with
   `lock_timeout` set, samples `pg_locks` for `ACCESS EXCLUSIVE` on
   `claim_evidence` and the other rewritten tables, records per-change wall
   time, temporary disk and index-build time, and refuses `sig-pg` (name
   check, tested). *(SIG-ENG-045)*
2. The rehearsal (L1, pre-authorised): pre-state → P34.6's drill command
   clones `sig-pg` at a point in time → read the clone's `sqitch.changes`
   head (the hosted head, P34.24a's fallback) → deploy the exact tip →
   measure → `sqitch verify` → name-checked delete. *(SIG-ENG-045)*
3. The record: `docs/build/reports/p34.24b-l44-52-rehearsal/REHEARSAL.md`
   (`date -u` stamped): plan tip sha256 + chain-tip commit, clone point in
   time, head before/after, per-change timings, max `ACCESS EXCLUSIVE`
   hold on `claim_evidence`, peak temp disk vs table size, verify result,
   clone-deletion confirmation and cost (P34.46's go/no-go inputs: lock ≤
   20 min and ≤ 2× this measurement; disk headroom ≥ 2× table size; plan
   diff vs this tip = 0).
4. Stop rules: any threshold already exceeded on the clone, a verify
   failure, or a clone point-in-time contradicting the recorded hosted
   head → record, delete the clone, `blockedOn`, ask (OM-18).

## Plan (Phase 1)

1. Extend `ops/src/ops/cloudsql_drill.py` `DRILL_INSTANCE_RE` to accept the
   contract-named `sig-pg-drill-l44-<stamp>` shape (`(?:-b|-l44)?` infix)
   so P34.6's name-checked `deleteclone` applies unchanged; `act_clone`
   honours `--clone-name` (still name-checked) so the same guards clone
   the rehearsal instance. Tests: accepted/refused name cases incl.
   `sig-pg`; clone-with-name stubbed happy path.
2. New `ops/src/ops/sqitch_rehearsal.py`: `assert_rehearsal_target`
   (wraps `assert_drill_name` — refuses `sig-pg` outright and every name
   outside the drill shapes); read-only snapshot SQL (sqitch.changes tip,
   relation sizes, `pg_stat_database` counters incl. temp_bytes,
   `pg_database_size`); the lock/index sampler (SELECT-only over
   `pg_locks` + `pg_stat_progress_create_index`, append JSONL);
   `parse_deploy_log` (per-change wall times from timestamped sqitch
   output); lock-episode grouping with honest bounds (observed window +
   2×interval); `build_record` → `sig.sqitch-rehearsal/1`.
3. New `sig-ops sqitch-rehearsal` CLI verb (DSNs via env, never argv —
   the `cloudsql-drill` rule).
4. New `ops/gcp/sqitch-rehearsal.sh`: `--check` plan-only default;
   `--apply head|deploy|verify` against the named clone over a
   cloud-sql-proxy: head read → background sampler →
   `docker run sqitch/sqitch@sha256:f247ab0e… deploy --verify` with
   `PGOPTIONS=-c lock_timeout=1200000` (the FEA-07 20-min ceiling made a
   bound, not just a threshold) → timestamped log → `sqitch verify` →
   post-snapshot → `sig.sqitch-rehearsal/1` record. `sig-pg` is never an
   argument the mutation path can take (name check first).
5. Live leg (in order): `restore-drill.sh --apply prestate` →
   `restore-drill.sh --apply clone --clone-name sig-pg-drill-l44-<stamp>`
   → `sqitch-rehearsal.sh --apply head` → source `pg_stat_database`
   pre-read → `--apply deploy` → source post-read + `sqitch verify` →
   `restore-drill.sh --apply deleteclone <name>` → post-state + `--verify`.
6. `docs/build/reports/p34.24b-l44-52-rehearsal/REHEARSAL.md` committed
   from the record; ADR for owned decisions (next free ≥ 191 = 197, if
   warranted); PR + `ci_boundary` read; closeout.
